segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Morning everyone. Let's walk the Q3 pipeline top down, starting with anything in commit.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Commit is at about one point four million. The two biggest are the regional hospital network and the logistics company in Memphis.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Memphis is solid. Procurement sent over their vendor forms yesterday, so we're in paperwork mode.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Security review is the long pole. They want our SOC 2 report and a pen test summary before legal will even look.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: I can get the pen test summary from the security team today.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Best case adds another nine hundred thousand, but most of that is the university system, which is a coin flip.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: They've been stuck at the committee stage for six weeks. I'm not counting on it this quarter.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Fine, let's leave it in best case but flag it. Femi, how are your new accounts ramping?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Slower than I'd like. I have three demos next week, all mid-market retail.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: Honestly the reason Femi's pushing so hard is the plan change. New reps are on a ninety-five thousand base with commission at eight percent of first-year contract value, and the accelerator only kicks in above one hundred and twenty percent of quota.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: And the senior AEs are on a hundred and forty base with ten percent, which is why everyone wants the strategic accounts.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, let's keep it on the pipeline for now. Rachel, anything at risk of slipping?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The insurance broker. Their champion just left the company and we don't know who owns the decision now.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's get an exec-to-exec touch on that this week. I'll ask our CRO to reach out.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: I'll pull together a one-pager on what they've used so far so the outreach has some substance.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Good. Let's update the forecast in the CRM by Friday so the board numbers line up. Thanks, all.

planted.quote: New reps are on a ninety-five thousand base with commission at eight percent
